messages:
julie_support: Heads up — customer ACME flagged a huge discrepancy between their dashboard token counts and the invoice. They say ~1.2M tokens on the invoice vs ~800k in dashboard for Feb 22-23. Can we confirm if we had any metering pipeline issues?
lee_sre: I saw an alert overnight about event ingestion lag on the metering Kafka topic. Partition lag peaked ~45m. Not sure if it caused double counting or missed events.
cory_infra: Confirming — there was a connectivity blip between ingest-proxy and kafka-cluster at ~2026-02-22T03:14Z. Proxy retried and backfilled but I need to check if retries created duplicate publish.
metering-bot: [automated] metering-consumer group had 3 failed commits between 2026-02-22T03:12Z and 03:20Z. Re-enqueued 11,452 events for replay.
dana_billing: Customer is asking for an itemized breakdown. We need a reconciliation report before we reply. Can eng run a replay and produce token-level diffs vs original billing dataset?
akshita_ml: Possible sources: prefix caching mismatch, KV cache eviction leading to longer generation counts, or replay duplication. We'll need sample request ids to sanity check tokenization differences.
julie_support: Sent ACME request IDs in DM (three ids). They also attached the invoice pdf.
omar_replay: I'm starting a replay dry-run locally to see if replay-tool produces the same token counts. Command I'm using:
```
replay-tool --from 2026-02-22T03:00Z --to 2026-02-22T04:30Z --topic metering.events --out /tmp/replay.csv --dedupe true
```
lee_sre: Use --dedupe=false for a control run too. If duplicates are present, dedupe step will hide them.
omar_replay: Good call. Running both now. ETA ~12m.
metering-bot: [automated] replay-job 9876 started by omar_replay (dedupe=true). Estimated 14m.
omar_replay: Dry-run results: with dedupe=true total tokens = 801,238; with dedupe=false total tokens = 1,205,981. Looks like duplicate events were present in the window.
cory_infra: That aligns with connectivity blip — ingest-proxy retried and republished on failure but idempotency key wasn't forwarded in some failure paths. Working on a patch to propagate request_id as idempotency key.
akshita_ml: For reconciliation we should produce a per-customer diff: original_billed_tokens vs deduped_replay_tokens vs raw_replay_tokens. I can run the aggregation job once we have the replay CSV.
julie_support: Customer will want credit for overcharged tokens. Dana — can we calculate provisional credit if discrepancy holds?
dana_billing: I can draft an interim credit based on deduped_replay_tokens. Need final signoff from finance but we can offer provisional refund and update invoice.
lee_sre: After patch, we should also run a compact-replay across affected day to ensure no other accounts impacted. I will schedule a full replay for 2026-02-22 window with dedupe on the cluster.
cory_infra: Patch deployed to ingest-proxy canary; forwarding request_id now. Need to monitor for any missed events.
omer_replay: Full cluster replay kicked off: job 9881. Using parameters:
```
replay-tool --job 9881 --from 2026-02-22T00:00Z --to 2026-02-23T00:00Z --topic metering.events --out s3://redwood-backfills/2026-02-22/9881.csv --dedupe true
```
metering-bot: [automated] job 9881 progress: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> complete. Output s3://redwood-backfills/2026-02-22/9881.csv
akshita_ml: Aggregation complete. Per-customer reconciles: ~98% of accounts unchanged, ~0.4% show >20% spike (includes ACME). I'll share CSV with billing.
dana_billing: Received CSV and draft credit schedule. For ACME provisional credit = invoice_tokens - deduped_replay_tokens = 1,205,981 - 801,238 = 404,743 tokens. Finance ok to credit at unit rate for Feb billing cycle pending final audit.
julie_support: I replied to ACME with interim credit and ETA for final reconciliation tomorrow EOD. They appreciated quick response :thumbsup:
lee_sre: Action items: 1) Roll ingest-proxy patch to prod, 2) Add test asserting request_id forwarded, 3) Add alert to detect consumer commit failures >5m. I've created a PR and linked tests.
cory_infra: Prod patch rolled at 2026-02-23T01:10Z. No further duplicate replays observed.
metering-bot: [automated] alert cleared: metering-consumer lag.
omar_replay: Closing thread — final reconciliation report uploaded: s3://redwood-backfills/2026-02-22/final-recon-9881.csv. Included checksums and SQL used for aggregation.
dana_billing: Final invoice adjustments processed and short-credit issued to ACME. Marking resolved from billing side.
julie_support: Thanks team. I'll follow up if ACME has any follow-ups.
